zh.caption: 圖 1｜授權判斷的四個因素
zh.description: 四列是共同參與判斷的因素，不代表先後步驟。

items.title: Context（情境）
items.body: 是否符合時間、案件關係等條件？

zh.caption: 圖 2｜安全的資料存取判斷流程
zh.description: 箭頭代表判斷路徑；失效或無權限即拒絕，不繼續讀取。每個資料入口都要執行檢查：讀取、修改、下載、匯出、API、批次工作。

items.title: 伺服器檢查工作階段
items.body: 失效 → 拒絕；有效 → 檢查案件權限

items.title: 檢查使用者對該案件的權限
items.body: 無權限 → 拒絕且不回傳資料內容；有權限 → 存取資料

items.title: 失效 → 拒絕
items.body: 停止處理，不存取案件資料。

zh.caption: 圖 3｜瀏覽器與伺服器如何維持工作階段
zh.description: 兩個角色分工；瀏覽器向伺服器送出 Cookie，伺服器驗證 Session 是否有效。這不是兩個依序執行的狀態。

items.title: 伺服器端概念紀錄（示意）
items.body:
Session ID → 隨機不可預測的識別值
User → A
Created → 建立時間
Expires → 失效時間
Revoked → 是否已撤銷

en.caption: Figure 1 | Four factors in an authorization decision
en.description: The four rows contribute to one decision; they are not sequential steps.

items.title: Context
items.body: Are time, case relationship and other conditions satisfied?

en.caption: Figure 2 | A safe data-access decision flow
en.description: Arrows indicate decision paths. An invalid session or denied permission stops access. Check every data entry point: reads, changes, downloads, exports, APIs and batch jobs.

items.title: Server checks session
items.body: Invalid → deny; valid → check case permission

items.title: Check permission for this case
items.body: No permission → deny without record content; permission → access data

en.caption: Figure 3 | Browser and server session responsibilities
en.description: Two roles work together. The browser sends a cookie to the server, which checks session validity. These are not two sequential states.

items.title: Conceptual server-side record
items.body:
Session ID → random unpredictable identifier
User → A
Created → creation time
Expires → expiry time
Revoked → revocation status
